title: Meaning and Impossibility of Exact Helium Energy Levels
exact_target: Make exact determination of helium energy levels precise, then prove or refute that such determination is impossible.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 7800014 (AMR-077-0014). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Andrew Lenard, original contribution to Open Problems in Mathematical Physics (1998), edited by Michael Aizenman.

status_qualification: The fixed-nucleus nonrelativistic model explains the terminology without silently resolving the source’s intended model or admissible exact expressions. The definition and the proposed impossibility theorem are both part of the target.
